title: To Strip the Flesh
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A one-volume collection of six short stories. In the title story, Chiaki, a transgender man bound by his late mother's wish that he become 'a beautiful bride', cares for his ailing father, a hunter, and finally transitions, finding understanding from those close to him. Other pieces include a figurine romance ('David in Love'), a body-horror mother-and-son story ('Hot Watermelon') and short comic pieces with ghosts cheering an idol group (Viz blurb via AniList/MU; ANN Spring 2022 Manga Guide).
life_message: Being understood by the people who matter, and living as who you are, is worth the pain of shedding others' expectations.

content.note: ANN warns of realistic scenes butchering game; MU Hunter/s.
Body horror in 'Hot Watermelon' and a disturbing dream of surgery (ANN).
Gender dysphoria and parental rejection (ANN; AniList Transgender).

dominant: Gender identity and transition; being understood by family; connection

Rural duty and caring for elders.

frames.aligns: Worth and dignity of a trans man.

Dignity vs honor.evidence: Worth asserted without retaliation; seeks understanding (ANN).

Order vs freedom.evidence: Chiaki 'sets out to remake himself in his own image' (Viz blurb).

Civic vs kin.evidence: Bound by mother's wish and caring for father, then a friend supports him (ANN).

Tradition vs secular-rational.evidence: Medical transition and a praised doctor (ANN) over inherited roles.

Survival vs self-expression.evidence: 'Celebrates the beauty of embracing who you are' (Viz blurb).

folkways.japan: The mother's wish that her child become a bride and rural hunting life reflect Japanese family expectations and countryside settings, described as context.

delivery.evidence: ANN: title story is 'not passively angry' and relatable; praised as skilled, not called preachy.
delivery.note: Parents' resistance is shown through grief and duty rather than villainy, per ANN.

winners_losers: Chiaki's self-understanding is vindicated and he finds people who understand him; parental expectations give way.
to_verify: Whether Chiaki's father comes to accept him in the end.
Nudity (AniList spoiler tag, 40%) and how the closing conversation with a gay writer is framed.
